nodes.label: Blind Hand Reveal Default
nodes.rationale: Revealed to both players at the end of each deal, purely for table transparency/curiosity. Cosmetic — a UI flag, not an engine rule.

nodes.label: config.ts Game-to-10 Constant
nodes.rationale: Game to 10 points is the default, expressed as a config.ts constant, changeable with no logic change.

nodes.label: Dealer Alternation Default
nodes.rationale: Dealer alternates every deal: standard, clockwise from the previous dealer.

nodes.label: Deferred Variant Rules ('few crazy rules')
nodes.rationale: Not blocking Phase 1 since they're additive/variant rules layered on top of the resolved shell, not changes to it — they slot in as additional config or additional action types without touching what's above.

nodes.label: Full-Blind Loner Hand Resolution
nodes.rationale: Resolved by sequencing, not actually ambiguous — blind selection (§1) happens for both players before any loner window opens (§2), so a full-blind declaration is always made with a selected hand already fixed; that selected hand is the lone hand. No separate rule needed.

nodes.label: Loner Sweep Scoring Bonus
nodes.rationale: A loner who takes 3–4 tricks (doesn't sweep) scores the standard 1 point — the tiered bonus (4/6/8) applies only to a clean sweep. A loner who fails to take 3 is euchred exactly as normal: defenders get 2 points, regardless of tier.

nodes.label: Misdeal Conditions Default
nodes.rationale: None in v1 — the blind mechanic has no exposed-card-during-deal case, so there's nothing to misdeal on. Revisit only if a real deal produces a dispute.

nodes.label: Redeal Default (stick-the-dealer off)
nodes.rationale: If stick-the-dealer is off and both pass round 2, the deal is thrown in and redealt by the same dealer. Config-only; flip the flag, no engine change.

nodes.label: Sequential First-Refusal Default
nodes.rationale: Non-dealer decides first within each window; if they pass, dealer gets the same window before it closes. Matches every other bidding round in the game (§3), so it's the same legalActions shape reused four times, not a special case.

nodes.label: Stick the Dealer (config flag, default on)
nodes.rationale: If both players pass round 2, the dealer is forced to name a trump suit rather than a misdeal/redeal — chosen as the default to avoid redeal churn.
nodes.norm_label: stick the dealer (config flag, default on)

nodes.label: §4 Tiers 2 & 3 Dealer Exchange
nodes.rationale: If the maker declared blind-trump or full-blind, the dealer still receives the upcard and discards regardless of who is maker or whether the dealer is even involved in the bid — it's a mechanical consequence of the upcard existing, not a bidding action. Kept private, consistent with every other hand-content rule in the game.

nodes.label: Fixed Trick Rotation Ring
nodes.rationale: Ring set once at the start of the deal (depends on selected/blind status, not dealer role); only the starting point changes trick to trick, set by whichever hand won the previous trick. Standard euchre 'winner leads next' applied at the hand level instead of the player level — no extra state needed.

nodes.label: Hand Visibility Rule
nodes.rationale: Only the hand currently taking its turn is shown to its owner. A player flips between their two hands' views potentially twice within one trick — once at each hand's turn — never seeing both simultaneously.
